newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Hamas warns of more attacks against Israel.
newsitem.headline: Hamas warns of more attacks against Israel.

text.p: The militant Moslem group Hamas, in a statement a day after a Tel Aviv suicide bombing, threatened on Saturday further attacks against Israel if it continued to build a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.

"The persistence of the Zionists to build the dirty settlement on Jabal Abu Ghneim will compel us to continue our attacks, striking against the Zionists," said a statement faxed to an international news agency by Hamas' military wing.

Israel's groundbreaking on Tuesday to build 6,500 homes for Jews on a pine-covered hill between Jerusalem and the West Bank town of Bethlehem, occupied in the 1967 Middle East War, drew international condemnation and Palestinian rage.
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has vowed to press ahead with the settlement at the site Israel calls Har Homa despite Friday's Tel Aviv cafe bombing that killed three Israeli women.

"We do not need much effort to prove our truthfulness and seriousness of our threats...to teach the arrogant Netanyahu a lesson he will not forget for days and years," said the statement signed "Iz el-Deen al-Qassam Brigades, Hamas Movement Military Branch, Jerusalem - Occupied Palestine".
An anonymous caller to Israeli police on Friday said Hamas claimed responsibility for the suicide attack.
The faxed statement on Saturday referred to the bombing as "a wonderful martyrdom operation".

It said "whoever thinks that the flame of Jihad (holy struggle) and resistance will one day be extinguished is mistaken...for the choice of Jihad and resistance is not an interim choice but a strategic one".

The statement said "the Zionists" would not be able to pressure Palestinian President Yasser Arafat to crack down on Hamas "because the movement's military appartus enjoys an independent, organised structure outside the borders of the self-rule areas" under his control.
The suicide bomber came from a West Bank village in an area under Israel's security control.
"We call upon our brothers in the Palestinian Authority not to listen to the Zionist threats and their despised wicked statements that push it towards raising national tensions," the statement said.

"In conclusion...Netanyahu has to realise that...failure to change his current policies will lead to an explosive situation and a crisis in the entire region," the statement said. "It will lead only to the most severe damage and horrible consequences."
